ad_intro:
Mokobara (mokobara.com) is a Travel Bags brand running ~30 active Meta creatives in India with estimated spend Rs.80L-1.2Cr/mo and ads pointing to website traffic to subscription/checkout. Premium luggage D2C.

The funnel leaks at three points: (1) Creative: premium look, packing-demo ugc thin - The gap: packing-demo / travel UGC. (2) Landing page: a premium-look page with no packing-demo proof. (3) Tracking: Pixel/GTM not verifiable on first paint; retargeting appears one-size-fits-all rather than segment-specific..

These are fixable in 7 days; we estimate ~30-40% of ad spend is wasted. Enterprise lead in active scaling/cost mode - pitch efficiency and CVR, not more spend.
ad_intelligence: Meta (Facebook + Instagram) primary; Google Search + YouTube secondary; app-install where relevant.
Several evergreen creatives running 30+ days - winners, but fatigue risk and a thin refresh cadence.
Category-siloed with limited concept testing; light UGC injection.
findings: Creative leak: Premium look, packing-demo UGC thin. The gap: packing-demo / travel UGC.
Copy leak: Current angle is product-led. Missing angle: travel-story + packing efficiency over premium look.
Landing page leak: A premium-look page with no packing-demo proof.
Tracking leak: Pixel/GTM not verifiable on first paint; retargeting appears one-size-fits-all rather than segment-specific.
wins: WIN 1 - Creative: Deploy packing-demo / travel UGC
Shoot 15 fifteen-second packing-demo / travel UGC and replace 30% of the weakest creatives. Expected: CTR +30-50%, CPA -15-25% within 10 days.
WIN 2 - CRO: Fix the landing experience
Add packing-demo + travel UGC on PDPs. Expected: CVR +30-40%.
WIN 3 - Tracking: Server-Side CAPI + Segment Retargeting

Fire Meta Pixel + CAPI server-side on key conversion events; build 3 retargeting audiences (visited but didn't convert / started checkout / dropped off) with segment-specific creatives. Expected: recapture 10-15% of dropped conversions; cleaner attribution.
